newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Q1 private wages rise 1.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Q1 private wages rise 1.3 pct.

text.p: Private sector average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE) rose 1.3 percent in the three months to February for a rise of 3.6 percent on the year, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
Public sector AWOTE rose 0.7 percent in the quarter to be up 7.1 percent over the previous 12 months.
Final AWOTE data for adults employed full time was revised to a rise of 1.0 percent from 1.3 percent, giving an annual rise of 4.3 percent.
Average weekly ordinary adult earnings (percentage change):
The bureau said the 1.3 percent rise in private sector quarterly earnings was the highest since the November quarter of 1995.
It said a re-analysis of seasonal adjustment factors had been undertaken for the February quarter and as a result some previously published figures had been revised.
